Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misattributed “The Bacchanal of the Andrians” to Nicolas Poussin (who died in Rome), conflating it with Poussin’s similarly titled “The Andrians/Great Bacchanal.” This misidentification set the task on the wrong track by focusing on why Roncalli left Rome instead of Venice (Titian, the correct artist of “The Bacchanal of the Andrians,” died in Venice). The error was later reinforced (e.g., Step 4) by ignoring evidence for Titian and mixing Titian’s dates/location with Poussin, leading to a misframed and incorrect pursuit.
